method: Viewed all original head/wrist frames and model localization overlays. Approximate image positions below are reviewer estimates, not calibration, input labels or contact ground truth.

cases.head_visual_review: Target button and marked contact finger are outside the head frame; unusable_head agrees with saved image.
cases.localization_review: 按钮框向左上偏移且碰到图像顶边，并未覆盖完整圆形按钮；箭头框偏上且未包含完整贴纸。指端点在所选右指前端附近但偏左下，模型标为partial。

cases.head_visual_review: Target button and marked contact finger are outside the head frame; unusable_head agrees with saved image.
cases.localization_review: 按钮框偏左，未覆盖按钮右边缘；指端点在白箭头所指右指前端附近，模型仍标为partial；箭头框未包括贴纸末端。

cases.head_visual_review: Target button and marked contact finger are outside the head frame; unusable_head agrees with saved image.
cases.localization_review: 按钮框明显偏左，右半按钮超出框外；指端点在右指前端附近，箭头框偏上；模型标为partial。

limitations: Each saved observation was requested once, except a schema correction for round 1.
Unknown is legal and preferable to an unsupported claim, but does not count as correct above classification.
Finding the approximate marked finger does not establish calibrated physical contact.
